trainer.note: computed within its own domain only; never pooled with pokemon subject-level values

functional.note: no independent collector-demand evidence exists; excluded from all Collector Roster Appeal candidates; retained as a Playability/Utility diagnostic only

B1_bounded_trainer_headroom_lift.note: structurally identical in form to the existing card-level bounded_score() Playability lift (B+(100-B)*lambda*(P/100)), applied one level up at the roster/bucket level; BETA chosen by architectural analogy to existing lambda=0.20, made more conservative, NOT tuned against price

B2_presence_aware_bounded_lift.formula: D = D_pokemon + (100 - D_pokemon) * BETA * (D_trainer / 100) * min(1, trainerGroupShare / 0.15)
B2_presence_aware_bounded_lift.note: trainerGroupShare = trainerGroupCount / (trainerGroupCount + pokemonGroupCount); full lift credit only once trainer groups reach 15% of named-subject groups in the set

C_domain_normalized_pooled.reason: percentile/z-score of a roster score changes score semantics per-set and reintroduces an unverified comparability assumption one level up instead of resolving it

D_separate_axes_only.note: product/contract framing distinction only: Trainer Appeal and Functional Utility surfaced as permanent separate axes rather than pending-calibration inputs

sensitivity.confoundNote: D_pokemon correlates 0.995-0.999 with pokemonGroupCount, trainerGroupCount, functionalGroups, and totalCards alike -- roster mass is fundamentally a set-size statistic, so the high D_pokemon/D_trainer correlation reflects shared set-size confounding, not domain-semantic equivalence

priceUsageDisclosure: no candidate weight, normalization, or selection decision used market price data at any point in this research
